transcript: When your back hurts, it is a sign the energy along your spine has stopped moving. In Chinese healing, we never wait. We open the river again with simple daily movements. Let me teach you three exercises my teacher made me practice every morning. One. Opening the gate. Stretch stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Raise both hands above your head, interlock your fingers and stretch upward as if you are pushing the sky. Hold for 10 seconds. This opens the spine and releases pressure in the lower back. Two. Swinging arms. Release. Relax your shoulders. Let your arms hang like soft ropes. Gently twist left and right, letting your arms tap your lower back with every rotation. Do this for 1 to 2 minutes. This loosens the waist, awakens circulation and melts stiffness around the spine. Three. Cat breathing. Spine. Wave. Go onto your hands and knees. Inhale as you drop your belly and lift your head. Exhale as you round your back high like a cat. Repeat 20 slow waves. This warms the vertebrae, calms the nervous system and relieves tension quickly. My friend, do these movements each morning and your back will feel lighter day by day. And if you want deeper healing practices for the whole body and mind, I placed a simple healing e-book for you in the link on my profile. Start reading it tonight. It may be the beginning of your new chapter of health.
